display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Fraunces semibold with optional italic terracotta place name.

body.purpose: Descriptions, forms, tables. Max 65ch for prose blocks.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows, footer column titles. Uppercase, 0.12em tracking.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Navbar on scroll, subtle hover states.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Mobile nav panel, booking form container.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Scroll hint ambient loop, divider reveal.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action on forms, nav CTA when scrolled, shuttle table booking.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #145555; color: #faf7f2; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0f4444; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #faf7f2, 0 0 0 4px #1a6b6b; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hero primary CTA, high-intent conversion actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #c45c3e; color: #faf7f2; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #a84d34; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #faf7f2, 0 0 0 4px #c45c3e; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Tour card details, secondary actions on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #0f4444; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #145555; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #edf5f5; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #faf7f2, 0 0 0 4px #1a6b6b; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Eyebrow above section headlines. Uppercase tracked label.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #145555; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Section Headline
components.description: Fraunces section title paired with section label.
components.css: .ds-headline { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 4vw, 2.75rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #2a2520; }

components.name: Tour Card
components.description: Circuit listing with image, meta, price, outline CTA. No shadow at rest.
components.html:
Baobabs de Majunga

Demi-journée parmi les arbres centenaires.

45 000 MGA
components.css: .ds-tour-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-tour-card-image { aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: #e8dcc8; border-radius: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tour-card-body { padding-top: 1.25rem; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-tour-card-title { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2a2520; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-tour-card-desc { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #5c5349; line-height: 1.5; flex: 1; } .ds-tour-card-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-top: 1rem; margin-top: auto; border-top: 1px solid #e8dcc8; } .ds-tour-card-price { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0f4444; }

components.name: Navigation Bar (scrolled)
components.description: Fixed top nav after 40px scroll. Sand background with blur.
components.html: MadaBookingCircuits
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; background: rgba(250, 247, 242, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid #e8dcc8; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(42, 37, 32, 0.06); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; color: #0f4444; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-brand span { color: #d4704f; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #2a2520; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #145555; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #145555; }

components.name: Weather Widget
components.description: Hero-only glass panel. Never reuse on other surfaces.
components.html:
Météo à Majunga

28°Ensoleillé
components.css: .ds-weather { background: rgba(10, 51, 51, 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border: 1px solid rgba(250, 247, 242, 0.2); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1.25rem; color: #faf7f2; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-weather-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a8cfcf; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-weather-temp { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-weather-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; opacity: 0.85; margin-left: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Booking form fields. Label above, sand border, ocean focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5c5349; } .ds-input { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid #e8dcc8; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #faf7f2; color: #2a2520; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1a6b6b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(26, 107, 107, 0.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8078; }

narrative.overview: Mada Booking reads like a local travel gazette, not a resort booking engine. Warm sand surfaces, deep ocean teal for trust and navigation, terracotta for the moments that ask for action. Typography splits editorial display (Fraunces) from practical body copy (DM Sans). Sections breathe with generous vertical rhythm; depth comes from tonal shifts (sand-50, white, sand-100) and ink-tinted shadows, not from stacked card shells.
keyCharacteristics: Full palette: sand neutrals + ocean primary + terracotta action accent
Editorial serif headlines with humanist sans body (max 65ch for prose)
Tonal section layering over nested card grids
Ink-tinted shadows instead of pure black
Scroll-driven reveals and hero parallax; no bounce easing

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Ocean carries navigation and structure. Terracotta carries conversion. They never compete on the same element.

rules.name: The Sand Floor Rule
rules.body: At least 60% of any public page surface is sand-family neutrals. Ocean and terracotta are accents, not wallpaper.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears only on display and headline levels. UI chrome, buttons, and forms stay DM Sans.

rules.name: The 65ch Rule
rules.body: Prose blocks cap at 65 characters wide. Wider text reads like a template, not a guide.

rules.name: The Ink-Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadows use warm ink rgba(42, 37, 32, ...), never rgba(0,0,0,...).

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Tour cards, tables, and highlight rows have no shadow at rest. Elevation responds to state.

dos: Do use sand-50 as the default canvas and alternate white / sand-100 for section rhythm.
Do pair Fraunces headlines with DM Sans body text and cap prose at 65ch.
Do tint shadows with ink charcoal rgba(42, 37, 32, ...).
Do use terracotta exclusively for conversion CTAs and brand accent wordmark.
Do animate with transform and opacity only; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use real Majunga-specific copy and i18n keys for all public strings.
donts: Don't use corporate blue (#2563eb) or generic orange (#f97316) accents.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as colored stripes on callouts.
Don't apply glassmorphism outside the hero weather widget.
Don't use gradient text, pill-shaped badges, or centered hero-only layouts.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing curves.
Don't use pure #000 or #fff anywhere in the system.
Don't add decorative parallax blobs or circular gradient orbs.
